partners.mechanism_chain: MKKS (HGNC:20735) —DISRUPTS→ Ciliary function (GO:0005931); Ciliary function (GO:0005931) —LEADS_TO→ Bardet-Biedl syndrome 6 (MONDO:0011523); Ciliary function (GO:0005931) —LEADS_TO→ Obesity (HP:0001510); Ciliary function (GO:0005931) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal dystrophy (HP:0000504); SMO (HGNC:10739) —BINDS→ Hedgehog signaling pathway (REACT:SMLID-70221); Hedgehog signaling pathway (REACT:SMLID-70221) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital hypothalamic hamartoma syndrome (MONDO:0009436); Hedgehog signaling pathway (REACT:SMLID-70221) —LEADS_TO→ Hypothalamic dysfunction (HP:0002105); Hedgehog signaling pathway (REACT:SMLID-70221) —LEADS_TO→ Obesity (HP:0001510). Loss-of-function mutations in MKKS disrupt ciliary function, contributing to Bardet-Biedl syndrome 6, obesity, and retinal dystrophy. SMO, a key component of the Hedgehog signaling pathway, is also implicated in BBS6.
